dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, thin high-contrast light-blue filaments forming non-concentric closed and semi-closed loops. The most prominent structures show a sharp transition from dark-blue background to high-intensity white/blue edges with a dark-blue interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid pixel clusters; features are primarily filigree lines. Small, localized high-intensity point-clusters are visible at the intersections of the light-blue filaments in the dorsal-midsection.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A loose scalene triangle formed by the centroids of the three largest 'C' and 'O' shaped light patterns located on the upper-right flank.
